items.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
items.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

items.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
items.summary: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.

items.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
items.summary: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

items.title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
items.summary: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
